author: GamingBolt
description:
It is worth noting that SAND: Raiders of Sophie is an Early Access title, and the developers have planned plenty of content for future updates. For the time being, however, the extraction shooter feels shockingly dull, despite its excellent idea of incorporating hulking mechs. 

Between the technical jank and general lack of polish, the in-game map also suffers from a complete lack of interesting sights or activities. While piloting a Trampler initially sounds fun, the lack of content makes this a difficult game to recommend in its current state.
title: Is SAND: Raiders of Sophie Just Another Extraction Shooter?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Resident Evil remakes have done quite well for the series, no doubt about that. But the ones that have been remade had a lot going for them since they were already solid additions to its illustrious lineup to begin with. But with chatter about a bit of hesitation to revisit RE5 and RE6, we thought it’s important to think about why that could be the case.

We’ve dived deep into that part of things, and believe that the developer is right to be a little wary of remaking those particular titles. Join us as we tell you why we think so, and what could be causing that reluctance. 

This one’s been a blast, and we’re sure you’re going to enjoy a look back at the franchise’s action-oriented era as much as we have.
title: Why Resident Evil 5 And 6 Are Harder To Remake Than Fans Think

author: GamingBolt
description:
Sword Art Online: Echoes of Aincrad invites you, for the first time, into its world away from the narrative beats of series protagonist Kirito. The ARPG blends real-time combat with party-driven synergy, with layered progression evolving with every new corner of the colossal, sprawling castle. 

Promising a new take on the Sword Art Online formula, here are fifteen key things you need to know about Echoes of Aincrad.
title: Echoes of Aincrad - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Purchase
